heading: Endorsed by Sheriff Mina
text: Commissioner Mike Crabb has earned the trust of public safety leaders because he has spent his life serving and protecting Orange County families. As a longtime deputy sheriff and public servant, Mike understands what it takes to keep communities safe and support the men and women who serve on the front lines.

heading: Backed by Law Enforcement & Community Leaders
text: Mike has earned the support of the organizations that know public safety, local government, and West Orange County best.

heading: West Orange Political Alliance
text: WOPA endorses candidates who share its commitment to responsible growth, strong communities, and effective local leadership in West Orange County.

heading: Florida State Fraternal Order of Police
text: The state's leading law enforcement organization stands with Mike — a proven public safety leader who will always back the badge.

heading: Orange County Sheriff's FOP Lodge 93
text: Mike's fellow Orange County deputies know his character and his record. Lodge 93 proudly endorses one of their own.

heading: Qualified and Ready to Lead
text: Mike Crabb has dedicated his life to serving Orange County. With 30 years of service as a Deputy Sheriff, experience working with Orange County mayors, and a record of solving problems for local residents, Mike is ready to bring steady, practical leadership to Orange County Commission District 2.

heading: Keep Commissioner Mike Crabb
text: Mike is running to bring experienced, common-sense leadership to Orange County Commission District 2. Your support will help us reach voters across Northwest Orange County.

heading: A Stronger Northwest Orange County
text: Practical priorities for the families, neighborhoods, and small businesses of District 2.

heading: Economic Affordability
text: Mike will work to tackle housing costs, reduce taxes, and attract high-paying jobs so families can afford to live, work, and thrive in Northwest Orange County.

heading: Reduced Traffic Congestion & Enhanced Transportation
text: Mike supports faster implementation of technology to improve traffic flow, strengthen connectivity, and expand transportation options for residents.

heading: Crime Prevention & Public Safety First
text: As a deputy sheriff with decades of experience, Mike understands that safe communities are the foundation of a strong quality of life. He will support first responders and work to ensure public safety remains a top priority.

heading: Smart, Responsible Growth
text: Mike believes growth must be managed responsibly. Development should meet the needs of residents, protect existing neighborhoods, improve infrastructure, and pay for itself.

heading: Parks & Environmental Conservation
text: Mike will work to protect wildlife, preserve natural resources, and secure grants to convert aging septic systems that are leaking into our watershed.

heading: Where does Mike Crabb stand on economic affordability?
text: Mike Crabb works to make Northwest Orange County more affordable for families by tackling housing costs, reducing taxes, and attracting high-paying jobs.

heading: Where does Mike Crabb stand on traffic and transportation?
text: Mike Crabb supports reducing traffic congestion with better roads, smarter traffic technology, and more transportation options across District 2.

heading: Where does Mike Crabb stand on public safety?
text: Mike Crabb supports law enforcement, crime prevention, and safe neighborhoods, drawing on 30 years as an Orange County deputy sheriff.

heading: Where does Mike Crabb stand on growth?
text: Mike Crabb supports smart, responsible growth that protects existing neighborhoods and pays for the infrastructure it requires.

heading: Where does Mike Crabb stand on parks and the environment?
text: Mike Crabb supports protecting the parks, wildlife, watershed, and natural places of District 2 for future generations.
